title: Hotel check-in
passage:
What time can we check in at the hotel?
A. The front desk said after three.
B. I checked the spelling.
C. The hotel has a swimming pool.
passageZh:
我們幾點可以辦理飯店入住？
A. 櫃檯說三點以後。
B. 我檢查過拼字。
C. 飯店有游泳池。
